t: Create PermissionRequest logger hook — builds CC Advisor observation data
description: CC Advisor needs data on what tool calls prompt the user for permission. A PermissionRequest hook logs each prompt to a JSONL file. This feeds the CC Advisor's Phase 2 (observation) and Phase 4 (auto-adjustment) — without it the advisor has no signal on what's causing friction.
perceive: Read .claude/settings.json to confirm PermissionRequest hook slot is available. Read CC docs for PermissionRequest hook input format (JSON with tool_name, tool_input). Check if ~/.claude/hooks/ directory exists.
execute: Create ~/.claude/hooks/log-permission-prompts.sh: reads stdin JSON, extracts tool_name + command, appends one JSONL line to ~/.claude/logs/permission-prompts.jsonl with timestamp, tool, command, project_dir. Add PermissionRequest hook entry to settings.json (no matcher needed). Ensure script is chmod +x.
verify: echo '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"rm -rf /tmp/test"}}' | bash ~/.claude/hooks/log-permission-prompts.sh && cat ~/.claude/logs/permission-prompts.jsonl shows the entry.
acceptance_criteria: settings.json has PermissionRequest hook entry pointing to absolute path
Hook appends JSONL line with timestamp, tool_name, command to permission-prompts.jsonl
